high.title: SMTP Configuration Field Name Conflict
high.description: Design specifies adding `smtp_enabled: bool = False` to config.py, but the file already contains `email_enabled: bool = True`. This will cause runtime AttributeError when email_service.py checks `settings.smtp_enabled`.
high.fix: Use the existing field name `email_enabled` consistently throughout Feature 1. Update all references in email_service.py to check `settings.email_enabled` not `settings.smtp_enabled`.

high.title: Missing Bursary Constituency Field in application_out Response
high.description: The `application_out` helper function does NOT include `bursary.constituency` in its return dictionary. Feature 3 endpoints assume this field is available, which will cause data inconsistencies in reports.
high.fix: Update `application_out` function in main.py to include `"constituency": a.bursary.constituency` in the returned dict.

high.title: Undefined api() Function Behavior for Blob Responses
high.description: The design references downloadReport which expects blob response, but new report endpoints return JSON. The api() helper function's handling of different response types is not verified.
high.fix: Verify the api() helper function in api.js supports both JSON and blob responses appropriately. Document in design that existing /reports/applications.csv returns StreamingResponse (blob) while new report endpoints return JSON.

high.title: Missing Filter Implementation: Reviewer Constituency Filtering
high.description: Report endpoints include reviewer constituency filtering but don't specify what happens when user.constituency is empty/None for a reviewer.
high.fix: Add validation: If reviewer has no constituency, return all applications OR return empty set OR return 400 error. Document the expected behavior explicitly in each report endpoint.

high.title: Ambiguous Email Notification Trigger Logic
high.description: Design states 'Send for major statuses only' but integration code unconditionally calls send_status_changed for EVERY status change. It's unclear whether the function should internally filter or the caller should filter.
high.fix: Specify in send_status_changed function implementation: Check if new_status is in notifiable_statuses list ["Approved", "Rejected", "Disbursed", "Additional Information Required"] and return early if not.

high.title: Unspecified Error Handling: Date Range Validation
high.description: Design states 'Invalid date range (end before start): return 400' but the endpoint implementation does NOT include this validation logic.
high.fix: Add explicit validation at the start of reports_overview: if start_date and end_date and end_date < start_date: raise HTTPException(400, "End date must be after start date")

high.title: Missing Sort Parameter Validation in Feature 4
high.description: Design states 'Invalid sort_by: default to date_desc' but does not implement validation check. Malformed sort_by values could cause SQL query issues.
high.fix: Add explicit validation before conditional logic: VALID_SORTS = ["date_desc", "date_asc", "amount_desc", "amount_asc", "name_asc", "name_desc"]; if sort_by not in VALID_SORTS: sort_by = "date_desc"

medium.title: Incomplete Feature: Deadline Admin Warning
medium.description: Design mentions warning admin when moving deadline to past date with active applications, but this logic is not implemented in update_bursary endpoint.
medium.fix: Add implementation in update_bursary or remove this requirement from the design as out-of-scope.

medium.title: Missing Index Recommendations
medium.description: Design mentions future indexes but Application.submitted_at (heavily queried in Feature 3) does NOT have an index. No data volume threshold specified.
medium.fix: Clarify: Application.status already has index. Specify: 'If dataset exceeds 500 applications, add index to Application.submitted_at'. Add to migration checklist.

medium.title: Reviewer Notification Logic Gap
medium.location: Feature 1, Section 1.3, Reviewer notification on submission
medium.description: Design doesn't specify: (1) What happens if bursary has no constituency? (2) What if no reviewers found? (3) Should email send happen after DB commit?
medium.fix: Add null check: if b.constituency: before querying reviewers. Document: 'If bursary has no constituency or no reviewers found, skip reviewer notifications'. Move email sending AFTER db.commit().

medium.title: Frontend Filter State Management Inconsistency
medium.description: Design shows BOTH backend API filtering (fetchFilteredApplications) AND client-side filtering (useMemo) which will cause double filtering and potential infinite loops.
medium.fix: Choose ONE approach: (Recommended) Backend filtering only - Refactor parent component to pass filter params to API call, remove client-side filtering. Update design to show parent component changes.

medium.title: Missing CSS Variable Definitions
medium.description: Added CSS references undefined variables: var(--yellow-bg), var(--yellow), var(--yellow-dark). Not verified if these exist in current styles.css.
medium.fix: Verify these CSS variables exist in current styles.css, OR add their definitions to design: :root { --yellow: #f59e0b; --yellow-bg: #fffbeb; --yellow-dark: #b45309; }

medium.title: Incomplete ReportsPage Component Integration
medium.description: Existing ReportsPage has signature {applications,download,busy} but design's new ReportsPage has {busy, run}. Not specified if old component should be replaced or renamed.
medium.fix: Clarify: Rename old ReportsPage to ReportsPageOld, specify new ReportsPage replaces the old one entirely. Update route call to match new signature.

nit.title: Inconsistent Email Field Naming
nit.description: Design refers to 'applicant email' but User model field is just 'email'. application_out creates alias 'applicant_email'. Terminology inconsistent but not wrong.

nit.title: Hardcoded Year in Application Number
nit.description: Application numbers use datetime.now().year. Unclear if count resets annually is intentional. Not a blocker.

nit.title: Missing CORS Origin for SMTP Settings
nit.description: Design doesn't explicitly protect SMTP credentials from API exposure. Should add to security section.

nit.title: Timeline Chart Accessibility
nit.description: Timeline chart uses div elements with title attributes, not accessible to screen readers. Should note accessibility limitations.

nit.title: Missing Error Boundary for ReportsPage
nit.description: If any of four parallel API calls fail, user experience is poor. Should add error state and display.

nit.title: Undefined run Helper in ReportsPage
nit.description: New ReportsPage receives run prop but doesn't use it—calls api() directly. Inconsistent with app's error handling pattern.

nit.title: Duplicate downloadReport Function Definition
nit.description: Grep results suggest downloadReport may be defined twice. Should verify in implementation.

conflictingSections.title: Filter Implementation Strategy Conflict
conflictingSections.description: Design shows backend filtering enhancement (4.1) but frontend uses client-side filtering (4.2). Backend code written but frontend doesn't use it.
conflictingSections.resolution: Commit to ONE approach. Recommended: Use backend filtering and remove client-side filtering code from design.

conflictingSections.title: User Requirement Not Addressed
conflictingSections.description: User requested 'it should not show amount unless it is allowed by admins at respective constituencies' suggesting constituency-level control, but design only addresses bursary-level show_amount field.
conflictingSections.resolution: Clarify with user whether: (1) Current bursary-level show_amount is sufficient, OR (2) A new feature is needed for constituency-scoped admin permissions. If latter, scope separately.
